newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira says wants 20 pct investment return.
newsitem.headline: Kemira says wants 20 pct investment return.

text.p: Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy has set an internal rate of return requirement on investments at 20 percent, its treasurer told a company newsletter.
"We have set an internal rate of return requirement of 20 percent," Kai Friman said in the newsletter received on Tuesday.
"At this moment there are plenty of investment projects with this hard requirement which means we will have to start doing some cutting back," he said.
The newsletter said new investment is required for real growth in group net sales to meet a five percent target, since the the five-year average is so far 2.6 percent.
Kemira also said group investment would be "well over a billion markka" this year. Last year it was 1.2 billion markka.
CEO Heimo Karinen wrote in an editorial column that Kemira's targeted net sales growth could be reached "through the cash flow of the business without weakening the equity side of the balance sheet".
